BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to transparency in state expenditures; adding a newsection to chapter 43.88 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The intent of the legislature, by enactingsection 2 of this act, is to make state revenue and expenditure data asopen, transparent, and publicly accessible as possible. Increasing theease of public access to state budget data, particularly where the dataare currently available from disparate internal government sources butare difficult for the public to collect and efficiently aggregate,significantly contributes to governmental accountability, publicparticipation, agency efficiency, and open government.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.88 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: By January 1, 2009, the office of financial management shallestablish and make available to the public a state expenditureinformation web site. The state expenditure information web site shallcontain the following information for the prior fiscal year, with the p. 1 SB 6818data in each of the following categories linked to the othercategories: (1) State expenditures by fund or account; (2) State expenditures by agency, program, subprogram, and budgetactivity; (3) State revenues by source; (4) State expenditures by revenue source; (5) State expenditures by budget object and subobject; and (6) State agency workloads, caseloads, performance measurements,and recent performance audits. "State agency," as used in this section, includes every stateagency, office, board, commission, or institution of the executive,legislative, or judicial branches. The state expenditure information web site shall be updatedperiodically as subsequent fiscal year data become available, and theprior year expenditure data shall be maintained as a historicaldatabase, with links to the tenyear budget data maintained by thelegislative evaluation and accountability program committee underchapter 44.48 RCW.
